title: Framepick by BPJ
description: English discovery of AI films, creator videos and series through official festival selections, publisher showcases and credited editorial collections.

methodology.scope: English-language discovery for international viewers and creators. These are global works, not a measured US or European popularity chart.
methodology.ranking: Browse sources and collections separately. Award labels reflect that source only. Editorial collections and publisher showcases are unranked; catalogue order is not an audience ranking.
methodology.metrics: No cross-platform views, audience geography, trending score or predicted success is available. Missing data remains unknown.
methodology.dates: Year identifies a festival/showcase edition, the year assigned by the curator, or a gallery article year. Source publication dates appear only when explicit and are not asserted to be original video upload dates. Checked dates record metadata review, not release date.
methodology.genres: Genres and short descriptions are BPJ editorial summaries based on source descriptions or named source channels. Source notes identify catalogue context where no plot synopsis is supplied. Empty genres mean insufficient source detail.
methodology.ai: AI classification comes from the organizer, publisher or credited editorial gallery. It does not establish that all frames were generated or independently verify the production workflow.
methodology.media: Watch on linked source pages or the video they embed. Films, episodes, trailers and general videos are labelled separately. Posters remotely reference the official Runway images or YouTube thumbnails; other cards use original typography. BPJ does not rehost films or third-party images, or claim redistribution rights.
methodology.access: Metadata and source-embedded video links were reviewed. Playback, uploader identity, duration where absent, spoken language, subtitles and regional access are not independently verified. Some source pages may require sign-in.
methodology.business: The directory is free. Official viewing links are not paid placements or commission evidence.
